panels.scene: Sam sits on a train, phone to his ear, looking out the window, a small smile forming.
June stands in her sunny kitchen holding her phone to her ear, gardening gloves tucked in her cardigan pocket, the small green kettle quietly on the stove behind her.
Sam pockets his phone on the train platform, shoulders relaxed, faint smile, nothing else in frame.
panels.caption: That was the whole call. It was enough.
